changed: Codex review round 5 on H4, six findings fixed with regression tests: wrapper timeout below the host timeouts (onFailure unsupported by the installed Claude Code; live check on 2.1.231 shows the scope hook still denies), case-folded protected-path and create-only checks, wrapper option arities, submodule foreach and bisect run after options, COMPOSE_* variables assigned, exported or inherited, source and . only in command position. The H4 handoff records the five rounds, the live check and the threat model.

rulings.ruling: Fail-closed scope checks rely on the wrapper timeout (45 s) rather than onFailure; onFailure stays in settings for releases that support it; live on 2.1.231 the key does not drop the hook
rulings.cost_if_wrong: if a future host timeout is set below 45 s, a stalled check follows the host default; a conformance test guards the ordering

rulings.ruling: eval and xargs ask wherever they stand as a word; source and . only in command position
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a literal word eval or xargs in a git argument asks the owner once

rulings.ruling: Round 5 informational finding (commands inside scripts) is accepted under the stated threat model, pending the owner
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a script that pushes or touches a container relies on the permission rules and an external sandbox
